# Ready to Build Your First Project?

Over the past 10 days, you've seen:

1. **The value proposition** — 30+ agents orchestrating end-to-end software
   delivery
2. **The problem** — 68% project failure rate from process breakdowns
3. **The solution** — 4 structured phases with Critic + Risk validation
4. **The proof** — Sprint 1 delivered 87% velocity with 113 tests and 0
   blockers

Now it's your turn.

## Three Ways to Get Started

### 🚀 Option 1: Try It Now (5 Minutes)

Clone the repository and launch a full project cycle:

```
git clone https://github.com/RobertAgterhuis/myAgentic-IT-Project-team-V2.git
cd myAgentic-IT-Project-team-V2
```

Open in VS Code with GitHub Copilot, then type:

```
CREATE [your-project-name]
```

The Onboarding Agent will guide you through requirements intake. All 30+ agents
execute automatically from there.
